actions.title: Collect missing observations
actions.description: Ask the observability adapter for available missing metrics, health details, and relevant logs; do not invent unavailable values.

actions.title: Review application errors
actions.description: Review existing application logs and error context around the failing request without exposing credentials.

actions.title: Review database connection evidence
actions.description: Review supplied connection errors and database availability observations; distinguish connectivity, authentication, and pool failures.

actions.title: Review service health details
actions.description: Review supplied health-check details and recent service events to investigate the reported unhealthy or degraded state.

actions.title: Review a possible database configuration change
actions.description: If connection evidence supports a configuration change, have the operator review credentials, endpoints, and connection limits before any approved change. No change is performed.

missing_information: Snapshot timestamp is unavailable; observation freshness cannot be assessed.
limitations: Confidence scores are deterministic heuristics, not calibrated probabilities.
This report uses one supplied snapshot; it does not establish causality or verify data provenance.
Configured heuristic thresholds: CPU >= 85 %, RAM >= 1024 MiB, response time >= 1000 ms.
Log window and completeness are unknown; supplied entries may be partial or historical.
RAM usage is an absolute MiB value; memory limit and utilization are unavailable.
Mock observations cannot establish the state of a real service.
